voci.riassunto: The Bureau of Labor Statistics will release the August consumer price index report at 8:30 a.m.

voci.titolo: Treasury Yields Surge as Oil Spike, Buyback Results Fuel Selloff
voci.riassunto: The US bond-market selloff accelerated on Thursday as spiking oil prices fanned inflation fears and the Treasury Department bought fewer bonds than expected during its first expanded buyback operation.

voci.titolo: Municipal Bond Yields Soar to Highest Since 2011 in Rout
voci.riassunto: Municipal bond yields jumped as much as 15 basis points with the longest-dated securities reaching the highest since 2011, as rising Treasury rates and heavy new issuance pressure the market.

voci.titolo: The likelihood of a Fed interest rate hike next week just got a lot higher
voci.riassunto: Traders pushed chances for a rate increase to 70% in morning action.

voci.titolo: Dollar Rises as Fed Hike Bets Grow Heading Into Inflation Report
voci.riassunto: The dollar rose as strong US producer prices and an oil rally boosted bets on Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes this year, putting more focus on Friday’s inflation report.

voci.titolo: Wholesale prices rose 0.4% in August, as expected
voci.riassunto: The producer price index was expected to rise 0.4% in August, according to the Dow Jones consensus forecast.

voci.titolo: US Yields at Multiyear Highs Bring Buyers to 30-Year Auction
voci.riassunto: Yields on US government debt rose to fresh multiyear highs — stoking demand for an auction of 30-year bonds — as surging oil prices bolstered the case for a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike as soon as next week.

voci.titolo: S&P 500 Slides Fourth Straight Day as Oil Prices, Yields Surge
voci.riassunto: US stocks fell for a fourth straight day, their longest slide since June, as the relentless climb in oil prices and fresh evidence of sticky inflation boosted Treasury yields and bets the Federal Reserve will lift interest rates.

voci.titolo: Stocks, Bonds Drop as Oil Spike Boosts Fed Wagers: Markets Wrap
voci.riassunto: Another rally in oil prices spurred losses in stocks and bonds, with the latest inflation data reinforcing bets the Federal Reserve will increase rates soon amid pressures from higher energy costs.

voci.titolo: U.S. reveals import ban on slew of Canadian goods as trade war escalates
voci.riassunto: Import bans on motorbikes, alcohol and dairy products are due to come into effect on Sept. 29 as the rift between the countries deepens.

voci.titolo: Why the Fed's interest rate call could come down to a few hundredths of a percentage point
voci.riassunto: As markets vacillate between which way they see policymakers leaning, all eyes will turn to economic reports measuring producer and consumer prices.

voci.titolo: Canada's retaliatory tariffs worth CA$27.6 billion take effect as trade rift with U.S. deepens
voci.riassunto: Duties on Canadian imports of U.S. steel and aluminum products have doubled to 50% as a trade war between Washington and Ottawa intensifies.

voci.titolo: Japan's foreign reserves drop by a record $80 billion in August following yen intervention
voci.riassunto: Finance ministry data showed that Japan's official foreign reserves stand at $1.207 trillion, down from July's figure of $1.287 trillion.
